address: 6/3 Siriphong Road, Samran Rat, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok, 10200, Thailand
bio: Not far from Bangkok City Hall, this eatery with a calm vibe serves just six authentic pad thai dishes, each aromatic and well-balanced. The crispy noodle version is a playful twist that teams deep-fried egg noodles with flavoursome sauce and a squeeze of lime. Deeply satisfying!
